decisions.reason: The existing same-message Event hides Big Block content but leaves About-page copy that still advertises the $6,000 Big Block prize.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Would it really be that involved? I expected redirecting the big-block pool to $54,000, giving me a $12 cut, and removing the related frontend content to be fairly simple, low-effort changes.

Finishing after by late October would not be ideal, although the impact should be limited at the beginning. Do you genuinely expect this to cause such a large delay?

value_updates.prize_collection_copy: Prize collection is automatic: winners receive $900 directly in their wallet and check the dashboard or email for notification; omit one-click redemption-control wording.
value_updates.prize_claim_copy: Prize winners receive $900 automatically in their wallet; the About page must not present a visible or one-click redemption control.

The candidate already records the $12 founder share, $10 affiliate commission, $8 prize-pool share, and Small Block-only destination established before this FAQ revision.
The continuing Small Block mechanism and its $8 purchase allocation remain valid and unchanged.
The obsolete Big Block ticket-counter attribute was already removed before the source Event.
Big Block ticket issuance was already removed, leaving only the continuing Small Block ticket rule.
The Big Block lifecycle and scope context were already removed; the Small Block ticket lifecycle remains unchanged.
A same-message MODIFY already records removal of Big Block content, and the remaining landing-page copy contains no explicit Big Block amount or claim requiring correction.
Generic transfer rules for active and expired prize tickets remain applicable to the continuing Small Block tickets.
Removing Big Block content does not change the $10 no-referral commission or its recipient-selection rule.
The provider, wallet provisioning, supported payment methods, and deferred lifecycle are unaffected by the frontend FAQ revision.
The requirement to display the book cover is independent of Big Block content and remains unchanged.
